fusion.inputs: BM25 top 50 and embedding top 50; no exact-match override
fusion.tuning: No tuning; fixed before inference; development reported separately from evaluation

variants.bm25-46: Unchanged #46 revised BM25 and its identical label/comment/IRI text for dense/fusion; GEMET SKOS definitions remain source-visible but unindexed.
variants.skos-definitions-v1: Separately versioned observed-text variant: add original skos:definition as description, capped at 512 Unicode scalars. Same candidate IDs/roles/scope, BM25 algorithm, dense runtime and fusion.

independence: Public AI-authored source-audited cases, no independent reviewer. Most target lineages disjoint; listed overlaps are correlated and never called unseen independent tests. No tuning in either split.
policy: BM25 retains #46 exact tier and conservative pre-clipping states. Dense/fusion have no exact tier or similarity threshold. Zero role-authorized candidates -> no_match, one -> low_confidence, more -> ambiguous_candidates before top50 clipping. No lexical veto, calibrated confidence, query interpretation, or execution.

adoption.uncertainty: Qualifying paired query-bootstrap lower bound >0; descriptive only. Independent relevance/usability review and separate owner/release decision still required.

timing: Warm: actual persistent Rust index NDJSON request/response IO + resident dense tokenizer/inference/rank/output serialization + fusion/output serialization; each frozen query once in source order, including first. Cold: fresh Python process imports/model load, stored vector load, fresh Rust import/build, one query and process teardown; five preregistered query indices; OS caches not evicted. Four Torch intra-op threads, one inter-op; no affinity/Metal.
intervals: 2000 query-level percentile bootstrap samples, seed37; correlated and AI-reference-only, not population intervals; n=5 cold p95/p99 are maxima.
controls: Original frozen #37-46 reports/fixtures unchanged; normal model-free replay plus fresh #46 lexical regression run. #48 remains separate retrieval-grounded parser follow-up.
